newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soyoil weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soyoil weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soyoil weekly export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 3,500 MT--the lowest since the marketing-year began--were primarily the result of increases for China (23,000 MT, includes 2,000 new sales, 21,000 destination changes), Mexico (3,000 MT), Haiti (1,500 MT), and Kuwait (1,300 MT) being partially offset by decreases for unknown destinations (25,300 MT).
Exports of 41,500 MT were two-thirds above the previous week and the 4-week average. The principal destinations were China (31,000 MT), Mexico (4,200 MT), Haiti (3,000 MT), and Kuwait (1,300 MT).
